name: find
description: Search the page's elements for text, a role or a value and return the matching lines with their refs and context. Use it first to locate a control such as a toggle, tab, button or link by its words.

query.description: Words to look for, such as Yearly, Specifications or Shipping; matched case-insensitively.

regex.description: Treat query as a regular expression.

tab.description: Which of this task's tabs to use, such as t14. Default: the tab you used last.

name: read_text
description: Read the visible text of the page, or of one element with target. Long text comes in parts: the result says the offset to pass for the next part. markdown keeps headings, lists, tables and link URLs.

target.description: The element: a ref from the latest find or snapshot of the tab, such as e12 or f2e12, or a selector such as text=Yearly.

offset.description: Character offset to continue from, as the previous result said.

frames.description: Also read the text inside iframes.

tab.description: Which of this task's tabs to use, such as t14. Default: the tab you used last.

name: snapshot
description: List the page's elements as an indented tree with a ref on each, to see what you can act on. interactive true lists only buttons, links and fields, which is much shorter; target lists only one part of the page. Prefer find when you know the words you are after.

target.description: The element: a ref from the latest find or snapshot of the tab, such as e12 or f2e12, or a selector such as text=Yearly.

boxes.description: Add each element's position on screen.

tab.description: Which of this task's tabs to use, such as t14. Default: the tab you used last.

name: screenshot
description: Take a picture of what a visitor sees: the screen, the whole page with full_page, or one element with target. Use it for charts, images, hover effects and how a part of the page looks.

target.description: The element: a ref from the latest find or snapshot of the tab, such as e12 or f2e12, or a selector such as text=Yearly.

full_page.description: The whole page instead of the screen.

tab.description: Which of this task's tabs to use, such as t14. Default: the tab you used last.

name: extract
description: Return the data the page declares for machines: product prices and availability, and every table as rows. Often the most exact source of a price or a spec.

tab.description: Which of this task's tabs to use, such as t14. Default: the tab you used last.

name: click
description: Click an element by ref or selector, such as a toggle, a tab, a 'show more' button, an accordion header or a same-site link. The result says whether the page navigated or changed and lists the snapshot lines that changed. Buttons that buy, sign in, submit, subscribe, delete or download are refused.

target.description: The element: a ref from the latest find or snapshot of the tab, such as e12 or f2e12, or a selector such as text=Yearly.

tab.description: Which of this task's tabs to use, such as t14. Default: the tab you used last.

name: hover
description: Move the mouse over an element and leave it there, to reveal menus, tooltips and card details that appear on hover. The result lists what appeared.

target.description: The element: a ref from the latest find or snapshot of the tab, such as e12 or f2e12, or a selector such as text=Yearly.

tab.description: Which of this task's tabs to use, such as t14. Default: the tab you used last.

name: scroll
description: Scroll an element into view with target, or scroll the page in a direction, to reach content that loads late or sits further down.

target.description: The element: a ref from the latest find or snapshot of the tab, such as e12 or f2e12, or a selector such as text=Yearly.

direction.description: Default down; top and bottom jump to the ends.

tab.description: Which of this task's tabs to use, such as t14. Default: the tab you used last.

name: press
description: Press a key: Escape closes a menu or dialog, Tab and Shift+Tab move focus, the arrow keys, PageUp, PageDown, Home and End move through lists and tabs, Space toggles. Enter works only outside forms. With target, the element gets focus first.

key.description: Key name, such as Escape, ArrowDown or Shift+Tab.

target.description: The element: a ref from the latest find or snapshot of the tab, such as e12 or f2e12, or a selector such as text=Yearly.

tab.description: Which of this task's tabs to use, such as t14. Default: the tab you used last.

name: select_option
description: Pick an option in a select box, or set a radio button or checkbox (option true or false), such as a region, size or billing period that changes what the page shows. Not for sign-in, checkout or other forms that send data.

target.description: The element: a ref from the latest find or snapshot of the tab, such as e12 or f2e12, or a selector such as text=Yearly.

option.description: The option's label or value, or true or false for a checkbox.

tab.description: Which of this task's tabs to use, such as t14. Default: the tab you used last.

name: search
description: Type words into the site's search box and press Enter, to find a page of this site. Only search boxes are accepted.

target.description: The element: a ref from the latest find or snapshot of the tab, such as e12 or f2e12, or a selector such as text=Yearly.

tab.description: Which of this task's tabs to use, such as t14. Default: the tab you used last.

name: wait_for
description: Wait until a text appears, an element reaches a state, or the URL contains a text, for content that loads after an action. Give one of text, target or url.

text.description: Wait until this text is visible.

target.description: The element: a ref from the latest find or snapshot of the tab, such as e12 or f2e12, or a selector such as text=Yearly.

url.description: Wait until the URL contains this.

tab.description: Which of this task's tabs to use, such as t14. Default: the tab you used last.

name: navigate
description: Load a URL of this site or of an allowed site in the tab, or go back or reload. Refs from before stop working; take a new find or snapshot.

url.description: A URL, or back or reload.

tab.description: Which of this task's tabs to use, such as t14. Default: the tab you used last.

name: dismiss_overlays
description: Close cookie banners, newsletter pop-ups and other overlays that cover the page, when a click fails because something is in the way.

tab.description: Which of this task's tabs to use, such as t14. Default: the tab you used last.

name: list_tabs
description: List this task's tabs with their URLs: the page you started on and any tabs a click opened.

name: close_tab
description: Close a tab that a click opened during this task, when you are done with it.

tab.description: The tab to close, such as t15.

name: report
description: Finish the task: send the facts you found for this page with a status. Call it exactly once, as your last call.

status.description: found: everything the task asks for this page; partial: some of it; not_found: the page and the pages it links to do not show it; blocked: a sign-in wall, a CAPTCHA or a refused action stands in the way.

lines.description: The facts, one per entry, each naming its subject and keeping the conditions the page attaches.

how.description: One short English sentence on what you did, for the logs.
